messages.subject: Equivalent of scantwo for 3 QTL
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to determine whether three significant QTL have a combined additive effect on a phenotype. Is there an equivalent to scantwo in r/qtl using 3 QTL?

Thanks,
Dantee

messages.author: 6f0e81f2684a02bb
messages.subject: Re: Equivalent of scantwo for 3 QTL
parts:
Hi Dantee, 

If I understand you correctly and you already know your QTL of interest, then you can use makeqtl() and fitqtl() to fit your loci to a 3 QTL additive model.

If you expect epistatic interactions between QTL you could go through with model selection (e.g. stepwiseqtl() as described in Manichaikul et al. (2009)).

I don't know of a three-dimensional genome scan implementation (I think it would be too computationally expensive), but maybe somebody else can weigh in.

Sandra Truong
